$comment: Source of truth for the weapon roster. Add, remove or retune a weapon by
editing this file, then run: pnpm gen:weapons
apps/api/src/Engine/Weapons.php. Never edit those by hand. CI fails if the
generated files disagree with this file, so the two engines cannot drift.
id           stable key used in ledger payloads. Renaming one is a
breaking wire-format change; adding one is not.
name         display string for the UI. Safe to change freely.
blastRadiusM blast radius in metres. Frozen spec: fixed radius per weapon.
damage       damage at the centre of the blast, in HP.
falloff      'linear' scales damage down to zero at the radius edge.
'flat' deals full damage anywhere inside the radius.
Damage values are placeholders pending balance testing. Radii were chosen
2026-07-20; note that 15 m is close to GPS accuracy of 5-10 m, so scout
near-misses will be contentious on a poor fix.
